statement: For every simple SRG(99,14,1,2) with complete actual-triangle incidence N and H=NN^T=A+7I, the lift-independent divided form beta(x,y)=X^T H Y/3 mod3 on V=ker(H mod3) is exactly the ordinary coordinate dot product x dot y. The ternary left code L=ker(N^T mod3) is therefore ordinary self-orthogonal. Constants have weights0 or99. Every nonconstant x in L uses all three vertex colors, each color class has size divisible by3 between21 and57, and its Hamming weight is one of42,45,48,51,54,57,60,63,66,69,72,75,78. No nonconstant dependency, rank improvement, circuit bound or target exclusion is asserted.
